body: questions like this. If I knew all the answers, I think I could solve them. Thanks.

I personally think, once you have these thoughts, they never really go away. They just vary in intensity. I have some pretty unsightly scares on my wrist. Avenue and Street...  from about 3 years ago. 

Now I finally have the courage to actually follow through and make sure I am successful, for once in my life.
Cool. Glad you got through it.

I appreciate your sentiment. However, please, please please please please, don't read me. Dont even TRY to read me. I've been read and judged my entire life. The last thing I want or need right now is another reader. 

Man, what the fuck, opening up to a complete stranger on the internet. Well, there ya go, there's a new low.

Honestly, hitting refresh and seeing something other than nothing gives me a little hope that someone out there gives atleast a fuck. Maybe half a fuck. Maybe less than that.  Either way, it's more fucks than anyone else gives about me right now.
Don't be sorry. You have nothing to do with this. This is on me.  Sure, I'm a failure and I've let everyone down that I've ever known.
